slides.title: Client Application Journey
slides.description: Rebecca Hartley-Vance completes her application on the JH&P Portal: tailored sections, validation, a joint applicant and the family company, source of wealth, the in-line AI assistant, evidence upload and signing.

slides.title: Client portal home
slides.subtitle: Progress, team and what happens next
slides.callout: As a client, I want to see where my application stands and who is looking after me, so that I never have to chase JH&P for an update.

slides.title: Validated as she types
slides.subtitle: About you
slides.callout: As a client, I want mistakes caught while I type, so that my application is not sent back to me later.

slides.title: Joint applicant
slides.subtitle: Parties complete their own part in parallel
slides.callout: As a client opening a joint account, I want Edward to complete his own section on his own link, so that I am not held up while he is travelling.

slides.title: The family company
slides.subtitle: Checked against Companies House
slides.callout: As a client service executive, I want company details confirmed against Companies House, so that nobody rekeys them.

slides.title: Accounts and objectives
slides.subtitle: Pre-filled from the first meeting

slides.title: Onboarding assistant
slides.subtitle: Appian AI agent, scoped to the section
slides.callout: As a client, I want to ask what a question means without leaving the form, so that I can finish in one sitting. The assistant answers only from JH&P guidance, cannot give advice and hands off to a person.

slides.title: Evidence upload
slides.subtitle: Completion statement received and sent to DocCenter
slides.callout: As a client, I want to upload one document and carry on, so that I am not waiting for it to be checked.

slides.title: Identity checks and signatures
slides.subtitle: Three agreements signed online

slides.title: The Onboarding Team
slides.description: The client service executive picks up the submission: the live queue, plain-English questions to the case assistant, and the full case in one place.

slides.title: Onboarding queue
slides.subtitle: New submissions, SLA warnings and what needs a person
slides.callout: As a client service executive, I want my day laid out for me, so that late cases and new submissions are never missed.

slides.title: Case assistant
slides.subtitle: Plain-English questions about live cases
slides.callout: As a client service executive, I want to ask which cases are late and what is outstanding, so that I do not have to build a report to find out.

slides.title: Application tab
slides.subtitle: Everything the client gave, read-only, beside the evidence

slides.title: Case overview
slides.subtitle: Outstanding items with owner, due date and action

slides.title: Parties
slides.subtitle: Multi-party onboarding with screening and invite status

slides.title: KYC and Screening
slides.description: A possible PEP match on a director: provider check, the screening agent's recommendation and a human decision with four-eyes approval.

slides.title: Identifier comparison
slides.subtitle: What we hold against the provider record

slides.title: Screening agent
slides.subtitle: The agent advises; a person decides
slides.callout: As a compliance-minded CSE, I want the AI to compare every identifier and explain its recommendation, so that I decide faster without handing the decision to a machine.

slides.title: Match confirmation
slides.subtitle: Decision, reasoning and confirmation, all required

slides.title: Second approval
slides.subtitle: Head of Compliance emailed for four-eyes approval
slides.callout: As Head of Compliance, I want every screening decision countersigned by a second person, so that segregation of duties is enforced, not assumed.

slides.title: Document Intelligence
slides.description: Appian DocCenter reads the completion statement, the team reconciles the fields, and a mismatch with the declared value is raised automatically.

slides.title: DocCenter reconcile
slides.subtitle: 32 fields extracted, side by side with the document
slides.callout: As a client service executive, I want extracted values beside the document with their confidence, so that I check rather than retype.

slides.title: Mismatch raised by AI
slides.subtitle: Net proceeds 6.3% below the declared value

slides.title: Review the evidence
slides.subtitle: Document beside the decision
